messages:
Priya: Heads-up — preflight for MosaicCare starts today. Goal: 14-day ramp to a limited pilot. Quick rollcall and biggest risks so we can triage.
Omar: I can take SSO + API keys. ETA for SSO config from their infra team?
Priya: @Omar thanks — they said mid-next-week but that could slip. SSO delay is top renewal-risk if it blocks admin flows.
Jordan: Adding data pipeline dependency — we need their sanitized export schema by Wednesday. If we don’t get it, we’ll have to mock for the pilot.
Sam: I’ll own the mock and interim stubs if schema late. Can we agree acceptance criteria for pilot?
Priya: Pilot success criteria (short):
- authentication + role mapping working end-to-end
- 1k sample queries/day with <300ms median latency
- training session completed for 3 power users
- no P0 bugs from sample workflows
Omar: Confirmed on auth mapping. I’ll validate role claims and send test accounts.
Lin: Scheduling enablement — suggest two 1-hr sessions: technical handoff (devs) and product walkthrough (ops). When works?
Aisha: Ops prefers Fri 10am PT for walkthrough. Product folks prefer next Tue. Can we do both?
Priya: Yes do both. @CS Bot please create calendar invites and attach onboarding checklist.
CS Bot: Created invites: Technical handoff Thu 9am PT, Ops walkthrough Fri 10am PT. Checklist uploaded: https://files.redwood/mosaiccare/preflight-checklist.md :white_check_mark:
Sam: Checklist note — we should flag a temporary fallback model (smaller) if quantized variant causes regressions during pilot. Saves cost and reduces risk.
Priya: Good call. Add fallback model in rollout policy, owner @Sam.
Jordan: Risk register update: SSO (owner Omar), schema (owner MosaicCare eng), training (owner Lin), fallback model (owner Sam). I’ll update the doc and share link.
Omar: Quick ask — can we get a sandbox token with rate limits similar to prod? Need that to validate throughput.
Priya: I’ll ask PM to request sandbox parity. If not available we’ll throttle tests to match.
Lin: For enablement materials — I’ll prepare a 15-min checklist demo we can reuse across accounts.
Aisha: We should capture feedback via a short form after each session. I can own the feedback capture and initial summary.
Priya: Awesome. Next steps: owners update risk doc by EOD, CS Bot create invites/docs (done), Sam to prep fallback model plan, Omar to push SSO timeline. Check-in here tomorrow 10am PT. :rocket:
Sam: On it.
Omar: Will update.
Jordan: Updated the risk doc and posted link in #customer-success-resources.
Aisha: Feedback form draft posted here: https://forms.redwood/mosaiccare-onboard — pls review.
Priya: Thanks everyone — short, actionable. Meeting link for quick sync: https://cal.com/redwood/mosaiccare-preflight.
CS Bot: Reminder set for tomorrow 9:45am PT for owners.
